articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Video and Audio Streams
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring real-time reasoning over continuous video and audio inputs with significantly reduced latency compared to earlier GPT-5 variants. The model demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on complex agentic benchmarks and introduces a new 'structured planning' mode that allows multi-step tool use with verifiable intermediate outputs. This positions it as a serious contender for enterprise automation pipelines requiring auditable AI decision-making.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Silver Medal Level on International Mathematics Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 scored above the silver medal threshold on a held-out set of recent IMO-level competition problems, building on last year's AlphaProof results. The system combines a large language model with a formal verification backend in Lean 4, allowing it to generate proofs that are machine-checkable. Researchers note this marks a meaningful step toward AI systems that can assist in novel mathematical research rather than merely solving textbook exercises.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has started performing supervised tasks at two Fremont sub-assembly stations, handling wire harness routing and component bin sorting. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22 degrees of freedom per hand and an on-board vision-language model for interpreting natural language task instructions. Tesla plans to scale to dozens of units across its factories by Q1 2027, though current operation still requires a human supervisor per two robots.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with 48-Hour Autonomous Operation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform targeting warehouse logistics and construction site inspection, featuring hot-swappable battery packs enabling up to 48 hours of continuous autonomous operation. The system leverages a new proprioceptive transformer architecture for whole-body dynamic balancing that dramatically reduces fall rates on uneven terrain. Early partners include DHL and Bechtel, with pilot deployments beginning in November 2026.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Claude Architect' for Autonomous Multi-File Codebase Refactoring
articles.summary: Anthropic released Claude Architect, a specialized agentic coding system capable of autonomously planning and executing large-scale codebase refactors across hundreds of files while maintaining test suite integrity. The system uses a hierarchical planning approach with rollback capabilities and has demonstrated a 94% success rate on real-world open-source repository migration tasks. It integrates directly with GitHub and GitLab CI pipelines, targeting senior engineering teams managing complex legacy codebases.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its N1.4 process node at its Kaohsiung fab, approximately one quarter ahead of the originally projected timeline. The node delivers a 25% power efficiency improvement over N2 and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator chips from Nvidia and Apple beginning mid-2027. The early ramp is seen as a significant competitive move against Samsung Foundry and Intel, both of which have faced delays at comparable nodes.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink de novo clearance for its N2 implant, which doubles the electrode count to 2,048 channels and introduces bidirectional stimulation capabilities for both motor decoding and sensory feedback. Early clinical trial participants with spinal cord injuries demonstrated cursor control latencies under 50 milliseconds and rudimentary tactile feedback perception through the device. The approval clears the path for an expanded 200-patient clinical trial expected to begin in early 2027.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment to Full Vehicle Pre-Assembly Workflow
articles.summary: Figure AI announced an expanded partnership with BMW to deploy its Figure 02 humanoid robots across the complete pre-assembly workflow at BMW's Spartanburg plant, moving beyond the initial pilot that covered only single-station tasks. The robots now coordinate in teams of up to six units using a shared spatial awareness model, handling tasks from parts inspection to sub-component fitting. BMW reports a 30% throughput improvement in pilot areas, with plans to replicate the setup across European manufacturing facilities.
